facts.fact: The U.S. Embassy's USAID project page lists among achievements that it developed and launched the RNE (National Business Register) website portal and created an online registration platform for businesses.

systems.platform: website portal with online registration platform

TUN.note: The page describes PFMIS upgrade work, a diagnostic and a debt decision support system, but does not state that a core system is in use or went live.
Only an upgrade of the Ministry of Finance's own data center is stated; no data centre for hire.

facts.fact: The U.S. Embassy's USAID project page says an online registration platform for businesses was created and the RNE portal launched, with taxpayer e-services listed as an objective.

TUN.note: Only training of over 400 Ministry of Finance executives in IT tools is stated; it says nothing of who runs systems.
Only an upgrade of the Ministry of Finance's own data center is stated; no nationally owned data centre for hire.
